claim_boundary: This contract isolates the scalar pure-liquid state required by the fixed-charge molecular-RISM branch. It is not a nonlocal-dielectric continuum state, finite-k liquid functional, total solvation calculation, force/PES result, or accuracy result.

construction.rism_observable_state: Fixed-charge RISM consumes T, molecular number density, and static epsilon(0). Pressure, compressibility, and surface tension are independent pure-liquid thermodynamic anchors. Optical epsilon(infinity) is deliberately absent because this branch has no separate solvent-electronic polarization variable.
construction.nonlocal_continuum_separation: The separate route2-v0-bulk-liquid-state-source-v1 retains epsilon(infinity) for a nonlocal-dielectric continuum control. Neither source record may manufacture a finite-k C_ab(k), a closure, or a total free energy.
construction.zero_mode_constraint: S_NN(0)=rho k_B T kappa_T=[1-rho c_NN(0)]^-1 fixes one projected scalar zero mode only; it does not identify a molecular site/orientational direct-correlation matrix.

current_inventory.decision: The DCM record locks independent scalar state to one exact source-model serialization. Its source-frozen AmberTools KH/DRISM feasibility audit entered a deterministic printed residual three-cycle and is rejected as a finite-k asset without changing a solver or closure. The source model remains below generator-compatibility, common-scalar, force, eleven-solvent, and accuracy gates.

required_before_molecular_liquid_or_tota: one source-complete all-atom molecular model bound to the exact state-source digest
a residual-converged source-provenanced finite-k molecular susceptibility/direct-correlation asset from a generator compatible with that model
a frozen solvent-side short-range and dispersion interaction in the same stationary liquid scalar
a source-bound bridge/kernel/planar-interface certificate when a weighted-density bridge is used
one common stationary liquid free-energy, standard-state, force, and production grid/orientation contract
validation_sequence: Verify strict per-property provenance, exact model digest binding, units, physical limits, and explicit false no-target/no-training policy.
Cross-check exactly T, molecular number density, and epsilon(0) against a parsed fixed-charge rism1d input; never inject epsilon(infinity) into that RISM state equation.
Require finite-k C_ab(k), generator compatibility, source-defined closure/long-range convention, and residual convergence independently; do not infer them from any scalar state field.

When a source-frozen numerical probe fails, record its exact model/state/input/runtime/cycle evidence as a negative audit. Reject only that declared candidate; do not perform a mixing or closure sweep selected from a solvation result.
Only after molecular-liquid, bridge, common-scalar, force, standard-state, grid/orientation, eleven-solvent, and blind-validation gates pass may a total-free-energy claim be evaluated.
decision_rule: Any missing source, model mismatch, RISM-state mismatch, finite-k correlation, generator-compatibility evidence, structural gate, or accuracy gate rejects the candidate. It does not authorize a guessed property, optical-dielectric proxy, closure switch or mixing sweep selected from solvation errors, proxy solvent, post-training, fine-tuning, solvation-label fitting, MAP/UQ calibration, response modification, or per-record model choice.
